scripts.dev:game-backend: node -e "console.log('[game-backend] go compile 中…（初回は数十秒〜1分ほど次のログまで止まって見えます）');" && go run -C game/backend ./cmd/server
scripts.dev:agent: node -e "console.log('[agent] go compile 中…（初回は数十秒〜1分ほど次のログまで止まって見えます）');" && go run -C Agent ./cmd/server
scripts.dev:all: node -e "console.log('\n[dev:all] game(8090)・agent(8091)・Vite(5173) を同時起動します。Go は初回コンパイルに時間がかかり、その間ログが少ないことがあります。止まったように見えてもそのままお待ちください。\n');" && concurrently -k -n game,agent,frontend -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:game-backend" "npm run dev:agent" "npm run dev"
scripts.test:clear-coverage: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('coverage', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('game/backend/coverage.out', { force: true });"
scripts.test: npm run test:clear-cache && npm run test:clear-coverage && vitest run --coverage
scripts.test:backend: npm run test:backend:clear-cache && sh -c "cd game/backend && go test ./... -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic && go tool cover -func=coverage.out"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:backend
scripts.cmake:all: npm run cmake:configure && npm run cmake:build
